versions.subject: refactor: split up rule into one low & one medium
feat: updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'PowerShell.exe'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'ForEach'
        - 'Xor'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.exe", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine="*ForEach*" CommandLine="*Xor*"
